Senses.Explanation: The fruit-stage is an attained result-position that Chan records can acknowledge, question, surpass, or refuse as a stopping place. Yongming Yanshou uses it in systematic exposition for the point at which benefiting oneself extends to benefiting others. Wuyi Yuanlai calls a venerable figure a person within the fruit-stage, then immediately says that from another view he is merely moving his toes inside his boots. Jifei Ruyi says the function of discernment can pull the dead directly beyond the fruit-stage. These uses preserve attainment language while making its status answerable to further appraisal.
